summary: Enroll in our Climate Change Adaptation, Mitigation, and Resilience training. Gain knowledge to enhance your ability to respond to climate impacts.
lede: Climate resilience training helps sustainability, risk and environmental professionals turn climate information into operational plans and investment decisions. Participants practise assessing hazards, exposure and vulnerability, developing emissions baselines, and prioritizing adaptation and mitigation measures. They also use scenario analysis and climate indicators to track progress and communicate evidence for organizational decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who translate climate science, emissions data, and resilience priorities into operational plans, investment decisions, and credible reporting. It suits intermediate to advanced practitioners who already work with organizational processes, environmental data, risk registers, capital projects, or sustainability reporting.
prerequisites: You should have practical experience in at least one relevant area, such as sustainability management, environmental performance, enterprise risk, asset planning, energy management, capital projects, or supply chain resilience. Familiarity with spreadsheets and organizational data is expected. No programming is required. You will use AI-assisted review, geospatial screening, and dashboard concepts at an operational application level, not at technical engineering or climate-model development depth.
